description: A dermatitis pattern caused or aggravated by exposure to light, including phototoxic and photoallergic reactions.
symptoms: Burning or pain in phototoxic reactions
Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation may follow some phototoxic reactions
causes: Phototoxic or photoallergic reactions to specific substances combined with light exposure
risk_factors: Exposure to photosensitising medicines or chemicals

appearance.general: Lesions often affect sun-exposed sites such as the face, neck, V of the chest, and dorsal upper limbs.

warning_signs: Extensive blistering or severe pain should prompt medical assessment.
prevention: Reduce ultraviolet exposure and use protective measures when advised.
